adn.translation: abbr. 德意志通讯社（Allgemeiner Deutscher Nachrichtendienst, 等于General German News Service）；先进数字网络（Advanced Digital Network）；己二腈（Adiponitrile）

adnascent.definition: a. Growing to or on something else.

adnate.definition: a. of unlike parts or organs; growing closely attached

adnation.definition:
n. The adhesion or cohesion of different floral verticils or
   sets of organs.

adnephrin.translation: [医] 阿德内弗林(成药,肾上腺素)

adneural.translation: [医] 近神经的; 向神经的

adnexa.definition: n accessory or adjoining anatomical parts or appendages to an organ (especially of the embryo)
adnexa.translation: [复] n.[解](器官的)附件(如眼睛的眼睑和泪腺, 尤指胚胎的胚膜及其他临时部份)

adnexal.definition: a of or pertaining to adnexa

adnic.translation: (=alloy)白铜, 镍铜合金, 阿德尼克铜镍合金

adnominal.definition: a. Pertaining to an adnoun; adjectival; attached to a noun.
adnominal.translation: a. 形容名词的, 修饰名词的

adnoun.definition: n an adjective used as a noun
adnoun.translation: n. [文法]名词格形容词,形名词
